title: Remaining multiplication bits
statement: For Boolean lists $a,b,c$ and a natural number $j$, define the remaining-bits condition to mean that $c$ has length at most $|a|+|b|$, the carry after position $|a|+|b|$ is zero, and at every position $i$ with $j\le i<|a|+|b|$, the bit of $c$ (taking a missing bit to be false) equals the sum of the carry and column value at position $i$, reduced modulo $2$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the carry and column functions, so their mathematical meanings cannot be stated from this payload.
